verses.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
verses.pt: E quanto à coleta que se faz para os santos, fazei também como ordenei às igrejas da Galácia.
verses.en_web: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
verses.en_bbe: Now about the giving of money for the saints, as I gave orders to the churches of Galatia, so do you.

verses.en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
verses.pt: Cada primeiro dia da semana, cada um de vós ponha alguma coisa à pate, reservando para isso conforme a prosperidade que tiver obtido, para que, quando eu vier, não se façam coletas.
verses.en_web: On the first day of the week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.
verses.en_bbe: On the first day of the week, let every one of you put by him in store, in measure as he has done well in business, so that it may not be necessary to get money together when I come.

verses.en: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E quando eu vier, enviarei aos que por cartas aprovardes, para que levem vossa doação para Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And when I come, I will send the men of your selection with letters to take the money you have got together to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
verses.pt: E se for necessário que eu também vá, irão comigo.
verses.en_web: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
verses.en_bbe: And if it is possible for me to go there, they will go with me.

verses.en: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
verses.pt: Mas virei até vós, depois de passar pela Macedônia (porque passarei pela Macedônia).
verses.en_web: But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
verses.en_bbe: But I will come to you after I have gone through Macedonia, for that is my purpose;

verses.en: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.pt: E pode ser que eu fique um tempo convosco ou também passar o inverno, para que me envieis para onde quer que eu for.
verses.en_web: But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
verses.en_bbe: But I may be with you for a time, or even for the winter, so that you may see me on my way, wherever I go.

verses.en: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.pt: Porque eu não quero vos ver agora apenas de passagem; mas espero ficar convosco por algum tempo, se o Senhor o permitir.
verses.en_web: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
verses.en_bbe: For it is not my desire to see you now, on my way; because it is my hope to be with you for some time, if that is the Lord's pleasure.

verses.en: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.pt: Porém ficarei em Éfeso até o Pentecostes.
verses.en_web: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
verses.en_bbe: But I will be at Ephesus till Pentecost;

verses.en: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.pt: Porque uma porta grande e eficaz se abriu para mim, e há muitos adversários.
verses.en_web: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: For a great and important door there is open to me, and there are a number of people against me.

verses.en: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.pt: E se vier Timóteo, olhai para que ele esteja sem temor convosco; porque assim como eu, ele também faz a obra do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.en_bbe: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear; because he is doing the Lord's work, even as I am:

verses.en: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.pt: Portanto ninguém o despreze; mas enviai-o em paz, para que ele venha a mim; porque eu o espero com os irmãos.
verses.en_web: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
verses.en_bbe: See then that he has the honour which is right. But send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me: for I am looking for him with the brothers.

verses.en: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
verses.pt: E quanto ao irmão Apolo, muito roguei que ele viesse com os irmãos até vós; mas ele de maneira nenhuma teve vontade de vir por agora; porém oferecendo-se a ele boa oportunidade, ele virá.
verses.en_web: Now concerning Apollos, the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
verses.en_bbe: But as for Apollos, the brother, I had a great desire for him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not his pleasure to come now; but he will come when he has a chance.

verses.en: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.pt: Vigiai, ficai firmes na fé, sede corajosos, e vos esforçai.
verses.en_web: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
verses.en_bbe: Be on the watch, unmoved in the faith, and be strong like men.

verses.en: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.pt: Todas as vossas coisas sejam feitas em amor.
verses.en_web: Let all that you do be done in love.
verses.en_bbe: Let all you do be done in love.

verses.en: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
verses.pt: Vós sabeis que os da casa de Estéfanas foram os primeiros da Acaia, e que eles têm se dedicado ao trabalho dos santos; rogo-vos, pois, irmãos,
verses.en_web: Now I beg you, brothers (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints),
verses.en_bbe: Now I make my request to you, my brothers, for you have knowledge that the house of Stephanas is the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they have made themselves the servants of the saints,

verses.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
verses.pt: Que também vos sujeiteis a eles, e a todo aquele que opera e trabalha junto conosco.
verses.en_web: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
verses.en_bbe: That you put yourselves under such, and under everyone who is helping the Lord's work.

verses.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
verses.pt: E eu me alegro com a vinda de Estéfanas, e de Fortunato, e de Acaico, porque estes supriram o que de vossa parte me faltava.
verses.en_web: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
verses.en_bbe: And I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for they have done what was needed to make your work complete.

verses.en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
verses.pt: Porque eles confortaram meu espírito, e também o vosso. Então reconhecei aos tais.
verses.en_web: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
verses.en_bbe: For they gave comfort to my spirit and to yours: for which cause give respect to such people.

verses.en: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.pt: As igrejas da Ásia vos saúdam. Áquila e Priscila vos saúdam-vos afetuosamente no Senhor, e também a igreja que está na casa deles.
verses.en_web: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
verses.en_bbe: The churches of Asia send their love to you. So do Aquila and Prisca, with the church which is in their house.

verses.en: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
verses.pt: Todos os irmãos vos saúdam. Saudai-vos uns as outros com beijo santo.
verses.en_web: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.en_bbe: All the brothers send their love to you. Give one another a holy kiss.

verses.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
verses.pt: Saudação de minha própria mão, de Paulo.
verses.en_web: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
verses.en_bbe: I, Paul, send you these words of love in my writing.

verses.en: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
verses.pt: Se alguém não ama ao Senhor Jesus Cristo seja anátema. Vem, Senhor.
verses.en_web: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. Come, Lord!
verses.en_bbe: If any man has not love for the Lord, let him be cursed. Maran atha (our Lord comes).

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.pt: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo esteja convosco.
verses.en_web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.en_bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

verses.en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.pt: Meu amor esteja com todos vós em Cristo Jesus. Amém. A primeira Carta aos Coríntios foi escrita de Filipos, e enviada por Estéfanas, Fortunato, Acaico e Timóteo
verses.en_web: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. So be it.
